What I've done:

- Logged the request as pending.

I didn't put the rate in my message to June, because I don't pass on what's said in DMs. If she wants the number, you can send it to her yourself.

Once she approves, I'll save the draft in your drafts with the rate in it, and you can send it from there. If you need it sooner, you could write it yourself, or I can save a version without the rate now.
